answer: Vesting clawback at the bridge: rewards unlock over 90 days, revocable if fraud proofs land. Any fable of instant profit dies because a farmer must forge 200+ identity proofs, each bonding 0.5 ETH, and a single slashed claim unwinds the whole vine of linked payouts. Cost to sybil 100 IDs: 50 ETH locked plus forfeited vesting, while honest agents risk nothing. The mechanism works because attack capital stays hostage longer than the attack can stay hidden.
